name: A Net Disaster
objectiveText: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake. Half-Eaten Fish  ( 7 )

comments.body:
This is actually a chain of quests:
1. [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=99127/a-net-disaster]A Net Disaster[/url]
2. [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=99128/slimy-menace]Slimy Menace[/url]
3. [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=99129/a-man-about-a-murloc]A Man About a Murloc[/url]
4. [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=99130/an-enticing-offer]An Enticing Offer[/url]
5. [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=99131/baited-for-success]Baited for Success[/url]

It will be impractical to attempt this chain on launch. There are less than 10 cage spawns for step 1 and they appear to operate on the "when one is looted, a different one spawns" method. So you'll be camping one spawn trying to loot it 7 times to get an item, likely completing with multiple others.
The second step will also be camped to oblivion; even with hyperspawns on the beta the entire murloc population was being wiped out.
These nets are really hard to see, but they will spawn right in the shallow water along the shores of the lake.

The lake was overrun with players, but I noticed [b]the river leading up towards Northshire Valley also had many trap spawns[/b]. Make sure to check this area as well. Some also spawned all the way underwater, so they're not just around the shoreline.
